title: 黑石苏世民：从中国巴士对话到AI基建布局
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We did see the whole AI revolution and then that's just because of an accident when I was in China
segments.zh: 我们确实看到了整个人工智能革命，而这只是因为一次偶然，当时我在中国

segments.en: in 2015, sitting on a bus with Jack Moore, who was the founder of Alibaba, and he started talking about that.
segments.zh: 2015年，我和马云同坐一辆巴士，他是阿里巴巴的创始人，他开始谈论这件事。

segments.en: And I literally had no idea what he was talking about and he explained that this would be the most consequential, technological change, which would change the world.
segments.zh: 我当时完全不知道他在说什么，他解释说这将是影响最深远的技术变革，会改变世界。

segments.en: So, I have a bunch of academic relationships, one of them was the head of MIT, and he said,
segments.zh: 我有很多学术界的联系，其中一位是麻省理工学院的校长，他说，

segments.en: Jack's underselling this. So, I said, how do you know? He said, because we invented AI at MIT
segments.zh: 杰克低估了这件事。我问，你怎么知道？他说，因为人工智能是我们在麻省理工学院发明的

segments.en: and we positioned the firm at Blackstone in this unique way, where we bought a very large data
segments.zh: 我们以独特的方式为黑石集团定位，2021年我们以100亿美元收购了一家大型数据

segments.en: center, a company in 2021, for $10 billion. It's now 15 times larger. With the largest owner
segments.zh: 中心公司。现在它的规模扩大了15倍。作为世界上最大的数据中心

segments.en: of data centers in the world, that puts us in touch with the six hyper-scalers, so because
segments.zh: 所有者，我们与六大超大规模计算公司保持联系，因为我们

segments.en: we work for all of them, so we know what's happening is sort of almost everywhere in this ecosystem.
segments.zh: 为它们所有人服务，所以我们几乎了解这个生态系统中每个角落正在发生什么。
